# cleanr

cleanr is an R package that provides simple helper functions for common
data cleaning tasks. It helps you summarize missing values, standardize
messy column names, and remove outliers from numeric columns.

## Installation

``` r

remotes::install_github("ADC-405-S26/cleanr")
```

## Example

``` r

library(cleanr)

# See missing values
describe_na(messy_data)
#>     variable n_missing pct_missing
#> 1 first_name         1          20
#> 2  last_name         1          20
#> 3        age         1          20
#> 4     salary         0           0

# Clean column names
df <- data.frame("First Name" = 1, "Last-Name!" = 2, check.names = FALSE)
standardize_names(df)
#>   first_name last_name
#> 1          1         2

# Remove outliers
df2 <- data.frame(x = c(1, 2, 3, 4, 100))
remove_outliers(df2, col = "x", method = "iqr")
#>   x
#> 1 1
#> 2 2
#> 3 3
#> 4 4
```

# Package index

## All functions

- [`describe_na()`](describe_na.md) : Summarize Missing Values in a Data
  Frame
- [`messy_data`](messy_data.md) : Messy Sample Dataset
- [`remove_outliers()`](remove_outliers.md) : Remove Outliers from a
  Numeric Column
- [`standardize_names()`](standardize_names.md) : Standardize Column
  Names of a Data Frame
